article-meta.related-article: This corrects the article "Efficacy of Lactobacillus reuteri DSM 17938 for infantile colic" in volume 96, e9375.

body.p: In the article, “Efficacy of Lactobacillus reuteri DSM 17938 for infantile colic: Systematic review with network meta-analysis”,[1] which appeared in Volume 96, Issue 51 of Medicine, affiliation f should have appeared as “Biomolecules and Infant Health-EIMYT Lab, Instituto Nacional de Pediatría, Ministry of Health, Mexico.”
